meaning:
δια-στολή, -ῆς, ἡ
(διαστέλλω), [in LXX for פְּדוּת: Exo.8:23, etc. ;]
1. a separation.
2. a distinction, difference: Rom.3:22 10:12, 1Co.14:7.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: even the righteousness of God through faith in Jesus Christ to all and on all those who believe. For there is no distinction,
Even things without life, giving a voice, whether pipe or harp, if they didn’t give a distinction in the sounds, how would it be known what is piped or harped?
